tool.name: FasTAN
tool.command: set -o pipefail && #if $input.is_of_type('fasta.gz') gunzip -c '$input' #else cat '$input' #end if | awk '/^>/{print;next}{print toupper(\$0)}' > in.fa && FAtoGDB in.fa gdb || true ; FasTAN -m -p -T\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} gdb && ONEview gdb.1ano | awk -f '$__tool_directory__/ano2bed6.awk' | LC_ALL=C sort -k1,1 -k2,2n > '$output'
tool.help:
**FasTAN** (Gene Myers) finds tandem-repeat arrays and splits them into repeat units.
The tool outputs **BED6**:
- **name**: `u<unit_size>` (tandem unit length) - **score**: unit identity (`1000 - 10 * divergence`, 0–1000 grayscale) - **strand**: real orientation
Pipeline: `FAtoGDB` -> `FasTAN -m -p` (`.1ano`) -> `ONEview` -> `ano2bed6.awk`. The tool converts the input sequence to uppercase first so it computes the mask from sequence alone.
